The frontend hook is `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`. The client is `web/src/connect.ts`. The proto RPC is `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`. The server handler is `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`. The store method is `store/memo.go`.

`useCreateMemo` calls `memoServiceClient.createMemo` from `web/src/connect.ts`, which hits `MemoService.CreateMemo` in `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`. `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` uses `Store.CreateMemo` in `store/memo.go`, and the SQLite driver in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` runs the `INSERT INTO memo`. The same insert exists in `store/db/postgres/memo.go` and `store/db/mysql/memo.go`.
